title: Hole C x-coordinate
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the x-coordinate of hole C as x_0 = 2mv_0/(qB) from the given reference ion's motion.

title: Length L on plate N
description: Essential: Correctly determines the length L on plate N where ions impinge, which is 2d.

title: Voltage U_0 for zero current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the voltage U_0 = mv_0^2/(2q) that results in zero ammeter reading.

title: Voltage U_x vs. x relation
description: Essential: Correctly states the relationship U_x = qB^2 x^2/(8m) for the translated analyzer, including the valid x-range.

title: Circular motion radius
description: Important: Applies Lorentz force as centripetal force (Bqv = mv^2/r) to find the radius for any ion velocity.

title: Velocity decomposition geometry
description: Important: Correctly uses geometry (2r cosθ = x) to relate ion trajectory parameters to the hole position.

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: Uses kinematics (v_y^2 = 2ad) under uniform electric acceleration (a = qU/(md)) to relate voltage to vertical velocity.

title: Vertical velocity condition
description: Important: Identifies that the vertical velocity component for an ion reaching the hole must equal v_0, based on the reference ion.

title: Velocity range application
description: Optional: Correctly applies the given velocity range (v_0/2 to √2 v_0) and angular range to determine the valid x-range for part (4).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the Lorentz force direction or electric field direction, or omits units in final answers.
